title: Component id list
description: One id list under data/oracle/: the component lists under card/component/, and the platform list at data/platform.json. Each entry holds the id that card and print data reference, and no value: the word one language shows for the id lives in the name list under data/print/<lang>/card/base/component/. IDs are unique within a list and do not change when a value is corrected.

id.description: The stable identifier referenced by card or print data.
